Periodontal Care

# Gum Treatment

Healthy gums are the foundation of a healthy smile. Expert periodontal care to prevent and treat gum disease at Krishna Dental Hospital, Gudivada.

Book Appointment

Understanding gum disease

## Gingivitis vs periodontitis

Gingivitis is early-stage gum disease where gums are inflamed, red, and may bleed during brushing. The good news? It's completely reversible with professional treatment and improved oral hygiene.

Periodontitis is advanced gum disease affecting the bone supporting your teeth. Without treatment, it leads to tooth loss. Early detection and intervention are critical to prevent serious complications and protect your overall health.

Know the signs

## Signs of gum disease

### Bleeding gums

Gums that bleed when you brush, floss, or eat hard foods are a warning sign of early gum disease that requires professional attention.

### Receding gumline

Your teeth appear longer because gums are pulling away from the tooth surface, exposing roots and increasing sensitivity.

### Persistent bad breath

Bad breath that doesn't improve with brushing or mouthwash may indicate gum disease and bacterial infection below the gumline.

### Loose teeth

Teeth that shift or feel loose indicate bone loss from advanced periodontitis and require urgent professional treatment.

Step by step

## How we treat gum disease

01

### Comprehensive assessment

We perform a thorough evaluation using digital X-rays and periodontal probing to measure pocket depth and assess the extent of bone loss and gum disease.

02

### Scaling & root planing

Using ultrasonic instruments and hand scalers, we remove tartar, plaque, and bacterial toxins from the tooth surface and roots below the gumline.

03

### Periodontal therapy

We may apply antimicrobial solutions and create a personalised treatment plan based on your specific diagnosis to promote healing and prevent recurrence.

04

### Maintenance plan

We establish a customised maintenance schedule with recommended cleaning intervals (typically 3-4 months for advanced cases) to keep your gums healthy.

05

### Regular monitoring

Ongoing check-ups allow us to track your progress, ensure healing, and catch any signs of relapse early to prevent future problems.

Why choose us

## Expert periodontal care

### Early detection focus

We use advanced diagnostic techniques to identify gum disease in early stages when treatment is simpler and outcomes are better.

### Advanced scaling tools

State-of-the-art ultrasonic scalers and precision instruments ensure effective tartar removal with maximum comfort and minimal tissue trauma.

### Personalised treatment

Each patient receives a customised care plan tailored to their specific gum disease severity, overall health, and individual needs.

### Preventive approach

We emphasise prevention through education, proper techniques, and regular monitoring to help you maintain healthy gums for life.

Common questions

## Frequently asked questions

Is gum disease reversible?

Early-stage gum disease (gingivitis) is completely reversible with professional scaling treatments at Krishna Dental Hospital in Gudivada. Advanced periodontitis cannot be fully cured but its progression can be halted and managed under the care of Dr. Vidya Sahithi MDS with regular periodontal therapy.

Does scaling hurt?

No, professional scaling and root planing at Krishna Multispeciality Dental Hospital is generally painless. We use local anesthetics to numb your gums if deep scaling is required, and our modern ultrasonic scalers ensure a fast, comfortable, and gentle cleaning experience.

How often do I need professional cleaning?

For maintaining healthy gums, we recommend a professional cleaning and checkup at our Gudivada clinic twice a year. If you are diagnosed with gum disease or periodontitis, our MDS specialists may recommend periodontal maintenance visits every 3 to 4 months.

What is the cost of gum treatment in Gudivada?

The cost of gum disease treatment in Gudivada depends on the severity of infection and the depth of scaling or root planing required. Krishna Multispeciality Dental Hospital provides transparent pricing. Patients can contact us directly through our booking page for an examination and customized estimate.

How does gum disease affect overall health?

Untreated gum disease is linked to serious systemic conditions like heart disease, diabetes complications, stroke, and respiratory infections. Protecting your gums at Krishna Dental Hospital in Gudivada helps lower systemic inflammation, supporting your overall health and well-being.

What are the best gum disease prevention tips?

Brush twice daily with a soft toothbrush, floss daily, use an antimicrobial mouthwash, avoid smoking, eat a nutrient-rich diet, and schedule professional cleanings every six months. Visiting Dr. Vidya Sahithi at Krishna Dental Hospital at the first sign of bleeding gums prevents progression.

# Privacy Policy

How we collect, use, and protect your information

Last updated: March 25, 2026

## Information We Collect

At Krishna Multispeciality Dental Hospital, we collect information to provide you with excellent dental care and services. Here's what we collect:

- Contact Information: When you book an appointment or contact us, we collect your name, phone number, and email address.

Endodontic Care

# Root Canal Treatment

Save your natural tooth with gentle, modern root canal therapy. No pain, no fear — just expert care in the heart of Gudivada.

Book Appointment

Understanding the treatment

## What is a root canal?

A root canal is a treatment to repair and save a tooth that is badly decayed or infected. During the procedure, the nerve and pulp inside the tooth are removed, and the interior is cleaned and sealed.

Despite its reputation, a modern root canal is no more uncomfortable than getting a filling. At Krishna Dental, we use the latest rotary instruments and digital imaging to make the process quick, precise, and virtually painless.

Know the signs

## When you might need a root canal

### Persistent toothache

Deep, throbbing pain that doesn't go away — especially pain that radiates to your jaw, face, or other teeth.

### Sensitivity to hot & cold

A sharp or lingering ache when you drink something hot or cold, even after the source is removed.

### Swollen or tender gums

Gums near the painful tooth are puffy, swollen, or have a small bump (abscess) that may ooze.

### Darkened tooth

A tooth that has turned grey or dark — a sign that the nerve inside may be damaged or dying.

Step by step

## How we do it

01

### Diagnosis & imaging

We take a digital X-ray to see the shape of the root canals and determine the extent of infection. This helps us plan your treatment precisely.

02

### Anaesthesia

The area around the tooth is numbed with local anaesthesia. You'll feel comfortable and relaxed throughout — most patients say they barely feel a thing.

03

### Cleaning the canal

We create a small opening in the tooth and remove the infected pulp tissue using precision rotary instruments. The canals are carefully shaped and disinfected.

04

### Filling & sealing

The cleaned canals are filled with a biocompatible material and sealed to prevent reinfection. A temporary or permanent filling is placed on top.

05

### Crown placement

To protect and strengthen the treated tooth, we fit a custom dental crown that looks and feels like your natural tooth. This is usually done in a follow-up visit.

Why choose us

## Root canal care you can trust

### Experienced specialists

Our endodontists have performed thousands of successful root canal treatments with high success rates.

### Modern equipment

Digital X-rays, rotary endodontic instruments, and apex locators for precise, efficient treatment.

### Strict sterilisation

Every instrument is autoclaved. We follow international infection control protocols for your safety.

### Affordable pricing

Transparent pricing with no hidden costs. We also offer flexible payment options so cost is never a barrier to care.

Common questions

## Frequently asked questions

Is root canal treatment painful?

No, modern root canal treatments at Krishna Dental Hospital in Gudivada are designed to be completely painless. Led by our MDS specialists, we use advanced localized anesthetics and digital rotary endodontics to ensure absolute comfort. The procedure is performed to immediately relieve the severe pain caused by infection, rather than causing pain.

How long does a root canal take?

At our Gudivada clinic, a root canal typically takes 1 to 2 visits. For standard infections, Dr. Vidya can perform a single-sitting root canal in under 60 minutes. If the infection is complex or includes an abscess, a second visit is scheduled to place sterile, clinical-grade dressings inside the canals to ensure success before sealing it.

What does root canal treatment cost in Gudivada?

The cost of root canal treatment in Gudivada varies depending on the severity of the infection and if a custom zirconia crown is fitted. At Krishna Dental Hospital, we offer transparent pricing alongside easy monthly installment (EMI) options so that quality dental care is accessible to all families.

How long does a root canal last?

A root canal-treated tooth backed by a custom-fit crown can last a lifetime with proper oral hygiene. At Krishna Multispeciality Dental Hospital in Gudivada, we offer structural crowns (like Zirconia or CAD/CAM ceramic) to reinforce the tooth, followed by biannual check-ups to monitor stability.

Is extraction better than a root canal?

Preserving your natural tooth is almost always the best option. Extraction requires costly replacements like bridges or dental implants to prevent jawbone loss and shifting teeth. A root canal treatment at our Gudivada clinic effectively cleans the infection while keeping your natural tooth functioning.

What happens if I delay treatment?

Delaying treatment allows the infection to spread to the jawbone, causing painful abscesses, bone erosion, and eventual tooth loss. If you notice persistent throbbing pain or sensitivity, our MDS specialists in Gudivada recommend scheduling a digital X-ray diagnostic scan immediately.

Cosmetic Dentistry

# Teeth Whitening

Get a brighter, whiter smile in just one visit. Professional teeth whitening that transforms your appearance without damaging your teeth.

Book Appointment

Understanding the treatment

## What is professional teeth whitening?

Professional teeth whitening is a safe, effective cosmetic treatment that lightens the shade of your teeth by breaking down surface and deep stains. Unlike over-the-counter products, dentist-grade whitening uses professional-strength peroxide gels that deliver faster, more dramatic results.

At Krishna Dental, we offer both in-office whitening for instant results and custom at-home trays for gradual whitening. In-office treatments are completed in 45 to 60 minutes, while at-home kits deliver beautiful results over 2 to 3 weeks with the convenience of treatment at your schedule.

Why teeth become stained

## Common causes of discolouration

### Coffee, tea & wine

Dark beverages and acidic drinks are leading causes of tooth discoloration. Their pigments stick to tooth enamel over time, creating stubborn stains.

### Tobacco use

Smoking and chewing tobacco cause severe, yellow-brown stains that are difficult to remove with regular brushing alone.

### Age & natural wear

As you age, the protective enamel layer thins, revealing the darker dentin underneath. This is a natural, inevitable process.

### Medications

Certain antibiotics (like tetracycline), antihistamines, and other medications can cause intrinsic tooth discoloration over time.

Step by step

## The whitening process

01

### Dental examination

We examine your teeth and gums to ensure they're healthy and suitable for whitening. We'll address any cavities or gum issues first.

02

### Shade assessment

We determine your current tooth shade using a professional shade guide. We'll discuss your desired shade and what's realistically achievable.

03

### Protective preparation

We protect your gums with a barrier and apply a desensitising agent if you have sensitive teeth. Your lips are protected with petroleum jelly.

04

### Whitening application

Professional-grade whitening gel is carefully applied to the front surface of each tooth. The gel is left to work for 15-minute intervals, often with activating light.

05

### Results review

We rinse away the gel and check your new shade. You'll see dramatic results immediately. We apply a fluoride treatment to strengthen enamel.

Why choose us

## Why whiten at Krishna Dental

### Safe professional-grade products

We use dentist-approved whitening gels with proper concentrations that work safely without damaging enamel or causing harm.

### Customised treatment

We tailor the whitening strength and duration to your specific needs, ensuring optimal results without excess sensitivity.

### Immediate results

You'll see results instantly with in-office whitening. Your teeth can become 4 to 8 shades lighter in a single 45-minute visit.

### Expert supervision

Our experienced dentists monitor the process throughout, ensuring safety and comfort. You're never left in the dark about what's happening.

Common questions

## Frequently asked questions

How many shades whiter can my teeth get?

Professional teeth whitening at Krishna Dental Hospital can lighten your teeth by 4 to 8 shades in a single in-office session. Results depend on your initial tooth shade, enamel composition, and the type of discoloration, all evaluated during your visit in Gudivada.

How long do teeth whitening results last?

Teeth whitening results typically last 6 to 12 months. You can maintain your bright smile longer by brushing twice daily, avoiding dark-staining foods and drinks (like coffee, tea, and red wine), and scheduling regular 6-month cleanings at Krishna Dental Hospital in Gudivada.

Will professional whitening cause sensitivity?

Most patients at Krishna Multispeciality Dental Hospital experience minimal to no tooth sensitivity. We utilize high-quality whitening gels and apply protective desensitizing barriers to ensure the procedure is safe and gentle on your enamel and gums.

Is professional teeth whitening safe?

Yes, professional teeth whitening under dentist supervision is highly safe and effective. At Krishna Dental Hospital in Gudivada, we customize the treatment concentration to protect your gums and tooth structure, delivering safer and superior outcomes compared to over-the-counter kits.

What is the cost of teeth whitening in Gudivada?

The cost of professional teeth whitening in Gudivada varies depending on whether you choose an in-office laser treatment or a customized at-home kit. Krishna Multispeciality Dental Hospital offers competitive rates. Please visit our contact page to schedule an evaluation and receive a personalized price estimate.

Who shouldn't get professional teeth whitening?

Teeth whitening is not recommended if you have untreated cavities, active gum disease, or are pregnant. If you have extreme tooth sensitivity, exposed roots, or existing visible restorations (like crowns or veneers which do not bleach), Dr. Vidya Sahithi MDS will guide you on the best options.

Oral Surgery
# Tooth Extraction

Safe, gentle tooth removal when needed. Expert surgical care, minimal discomfort, speedy healing — all at Krishna Dental.

Book Appointment

Know when you need it
## When is extraction necessary?

While we always try to save your natural tooth, sometimes extraction is the best option for your long-term oral health. Here are the most common reasons why tooth extraction becomes necessary:

Severely damaged or decayed teeth — When decay reaches deep into the tooth and root canal treatment isn't viable, extraction prevents infection from spreading.

Advanced periodontal disease — When gum disease has destroyed the bone supporting the tooth, it can no longer be saved and must be removed.

Overcrowding — Extracting teeth creates space for orthodontic alignment and a better bite.

Impacted wisdom teeth — Third molars that are trapped or growing at an angle must be surgically removed to prevent pain and damage to adjacent teeth.
Different approaches
## Types of extraction

### Simple extraction

For teeth that are visible and easily accessible. The tooth is loosened and removed gently. Quick and straightforward with minimal trauma.

### Surgical extraction

For impacted teeth or teeth that can't be accessed directly. We may remove bone or split the tooth into sections for safe removal.

### Wisdom tooth removal

Third molars are often impacted or partially erupted. Our surgeons remove them with precision to prevent pain and future complications.

### Multiple extractions

Sometimes several teeth need removal for orthodontics or due to severe decay. We plan carefully to minimise healing time and maintain oral health.
Step by step
## The extraction procedure
01
### Evaluation & X-rays

We examine the tooth and take digital X-rays to see the roots, bone structure, and any complications. This helps us plan the safest extraction approach.
02
### Anaesthesia

Local anaesthesia is administered to numb the tooth and surrounding area. You'll feel pressure and vibration, but no pain. We make sure you're completely comfortable.
03
### Extraction

The tooth is carefully loosened using specialised instruments, then gently removed. For complex cases, we may remove bone or divide the tooth into sections.
04
### Socket care

The extraction site is cleaned and may be closed with sutures if needed. A gauze pad is placed to help form a blood clot, which is essential for proper healing.
05
### Recovery & healing

You'll receive detailed aftercare instructions to manage swelling, prevent infection, and promote faster healing. Most people feel normal within a few days.
Your wellbeing matters
## Your comfort is our priority

### Gentle surgical technique

Minimal trauma, precise instruments, and careful handling of tissues. Our surgeons prioritise speed and gentleness to reduce post-operative swelling.

### Modern anaesthesia

Latest anaesthetic agents ensure you stay completely numb and relaxed. We also use techniques to make injections as painless as possible.

### Clear aftercare instructions

We provide detailed written and verbal instructions on how to care for the extraction site, manage pain, and prevent complications like dry socket.

### Follow-up care

We schedule a post-operative check-up to ensure proper healing and address any questions or concerns you may have during recovery.

## Frequently asked questions
Is tooth extraction painful?
No. With modern local anesthesia at Krishna Multispeciality Dental Hospital, tooth extraction is virtually painless. While you will feel some pressure during the procedure, you will not feel pain. Any mild post-extraction soreness is easily managed with prescribed medication.                                      How long does recovery take?
Most patients recover from a tooth extraction in Gudivada within a few days. The soft tissue at the extraction site heals completely in about 2 weeks, while full bone healing takes a few months. Dr. Vidya Sahithi MDS provides detailed aftercare guidelines to ensure a quick recovery.                                      Can I eat after tooth extraction?
We recommend avoiding eating for at least 4 to 6 hours after your extraction at our Gudivada clinic to allow the blood clot to stabilize. After that, stick to soft, cool foods (like yogurt, pudding, or soup) for the first 24 to 48 hours, and avoid drinking through straws.                                      How do I prevent dry socket?
To prevent dry socket after an extraction at Krishna Dental Hospital, avoid smoking, drinking through a straw, or spitting forcefully for the first 3 to 5 days. These actions can dislodge the healing blood clot. Follow all post-operative instructions provided by our surgical team.                                      What is the cost of tooth extraction in Gudivada?
The cost of tooth extraction in Gudivada depends on whether the tooth is visible (simple extraction) or impacted/broken (surgical extraction). Krishna Multispeciality Dental Hospital offers transparent, competitive pricing. Please visit our contact page to request a personal estimate.                                      What are my tooth replacement options?
After an extraction, it is important to replace the missing tooth to prevent shifting. Krishna Dental Hospital in Gudivada offers premium dental implants (most durable and natural), custom dental bridges, and modern dentures to restore your smile's function.

## Page: wisdom-tooth-gudivada.html
**URL:** https://www.krishnadental.in/wisdom-tooth-gudivada.html

Oral Surgery

# Wisdom Tooth Removal

Safe extraction of impacted or problematic wisdom teeth. Expert care, minimal discomfort, and fast recovery with our experienced oral surgeons.

Book Appointment

Understanding the issue

## Why wisdom teeth cause problems

Wisdom teeth (third molars) are the last teeth to develop, usually erupting in your late teens to early twenties. Most people don't have enough jaw space for them to grow properly.

When wisdom teeth come in at wrong angles or don't have room to erupt fully, they can become impacted, causing pain, infection, and crowding of nearby teeth. Early removal prevents complications and makes recovery much faster.

Know the warning signs

## Signs you might need removal

### Pain at the back of mouth

Sharp or throbbing pain at the back of your jaw, especially around the molars. This often worsens when chewing.

### Swollen or inflamed gums

Gums around the back molars are tender, red, or swollen — sometimes with difficulty opening your mouth.

### Jaw stiffness and limited opening

Difficulty opening your mouth wide or feeling stiffness in your jaw, making eating and speaking uncomfortable.

### Crowding of other teeth

Your front teeth are becoming crowded or shifting position, pushing against other teeth and affecting your bite.

Your procedure

## How we extract wisdom teeth

01

### X-ray & assessment

We take advanced X-rays to see the exact position, angle, and depth of your wisdom teeth. This allows us to plan the safest extraction technique.

02

### Treatment planning

We discuss the procedure, options (single or multiple extractions), and expected recovery time. You'll understand exactly what to expect before we begin.

03

### Extraction procedure

Under local anaesthesia, our experienced oral surgeons carefully extract the wisdom teeth using precise techniques. The entire procedure is painless, though you may feel pressure or hear sounds.

04

### Recovery guidance

We provide detailed post-operative instructions including medications, dietary recommendations, and activity restrictions. Most patients return to normal activities within 2 weeks.

05

### Follow-up check

We schedule follow-up visits to ensure proper healing and address any concerns. Any stitches are removed as needed, and we monitor your recovery.

Why choose us

## Expert surgical care

### Experienced oral surgeons

Our surgeons have extensive training and experience in complex wisdom tooth extractions with proven track records of safe, successful procedures.

### Minimal discomfort

Using modern techniques, precision instruments, and effective anaesthesia, we ensure your procedure is as comfortable as possible with minimal pain.

### Fast recovery

Most patients experience minimal swelling and return to normal activities within 2 weeks. Our post-operative care instructions ensure smooth, speedy healing.

### Comprehensive aftercare

We provide detailed instructions, medications, and follow-up care to prevent complications. Our team is available for any questions during your recovery.

Common questions

## Frequently asked questions

Is wisdom tooth removal really necessary?

Not all wisdom teeth require extraction. However, if a third molar is impacted, crowding nearby teeth, or causing chronic swelling (pericoronitis), our specialists at Krishna Dental Hospital in Gudivada recommend surgical extraction to safeguard your overall oral health.

How painful is the extraction procedure?

The wisdom tooth extraction procedure itself is completely painless. At our Gudivada clinic, our experienced oral surgeons use advanced local anesthetics to ensure complete numbness, so you only feel mild pressure during the procedure. Post-operative discomfort is easily managed with prescribed recovery medications.

How long is the recovery time?

Initial soft tissue healing takes about 7 to 10 days. At Krishna Multispeciality Dental Hospital, we provide comprehensive recovery kits and instructions. While you can comfortably resume normal activities in Gudivada within a couple of days, complete bone healing in the socket takes about 3 to 6 months.

What can I eat after removal?

Yes, but you must stick to soft, cool foods (like curd, smoothies, and mashed potatoes) for the first 24 to 48 hours. Avoid hot, spicy, or crunchy foods, and do not use a straw, as the suction can dislodge the healing blood clot.

How much does wisdom tooth extraction cost in Gudivada?

The cost of wisdom tooth removal in Gudivada depends on whether it is a simple extraction or a complex surgical extraction for an impacted tooth. At Krishna Dental, we provide transparent, upfront pricing details during your initial digital X-ray evaluation.

What if I don't remove my wisdom teeth?

Leaving impacted wisdom teeth untreated can lead to severe tooth decay in neighboring molars, painful gum infections, cyst formation, and bite misalignment. Early surgical evaluation at our Gudivada clinic prevents these complex conditions.

## Don't wait for complications

Schedule a consultation at Krishna Dental today. Our surgeons will assess your wisdom teeth and recommend the best course of action.
